display_information.name: NORTH
display_information.long_description: NORTH is the Clay team's single front door to the Clay AI system. Ask NORTH a question, request research, ask for product, design, or copy work, request an implementation on a review branch, or ask where something stands. NORTH runs the work internally and brings one finished answer back to the same thread. Work that takes time gets an immediate acknowledgement first, then a single reply marked DONE, READY FOR REVIEW, NEEDS YOUR DECISION, or BLOCKED. NORTH completes everything reversible on its own. Anything that needs production, publishing, spend, or access authority is prepared in full and then handed to the right approver rather than being dropped.

assistant_view.assistant_description: Ask NORTH for Clay work, research, status, or a review.
